text: Harvest the test suite as RETIREMENT targets, never as new lessons: every assertion label is already a gate, so importing 3,898 of them multiplies the proposal backlog while adding nothing executable. Use them to retire prose a test already enforces - and report only the exact-text tier, because overlap thresholds lie: >=3 shared words gave 70 cms pairs whose inspected samples were coincidental, while exact text gave 22 real copies of existing gates.
